utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I have a sharp pain on the right side of my chest. It got much worse overnight and it really stabs when I take a deep breath.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I've also been coughing, and this morning there was a streak of blood in it. My right calf has been swollen and sore since last week.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I flew back from Singapore ten days ago, and I'm on birth control pills. Nobody in my family has had clots that I know of.
